title: Eggman in the Lotus Pond
description: A surreal anthropomorphic egg character with a wrinkled human-like face, pink curly hair, and a pinstripe suit stands waist-deep in a pond covered with green lily pads and pink lotus flowers. He smirks while adjusting his tie, with dramatic orange light rays bursting from behind him against a dark, stormy sky with red glowing clouds.
prompt: A surreal scene of an anthropomorphic egg with a detailed elderly human face, rosy cheeks, and pink curly styled hair, wearing a dark pinstripe suit and red tie. He stands in a pond filled with green lily pads and blooming pink lotus flowers, smirking confidently while adjusting his tie with one hand raised. Dramatic orange god rays pierce through dark stormy clouds with a glowing red sky behind him, cinematic surreal style, detailed textures, moody atmosphere.
